summary.name: Offer IN
summary.one_liner: Offerin is a Chinese-language AI interview and online assessment assistant that generates suggested answers in real time on a second device while you take live interviews or online tests.
keywords: 行测 图推 资料分析
use_cases: Practicing mock interviews before a job interview
Getting AI-suggested answers during a live online interview
Solving online coding or aptitude tests with screenshot control
Helping interviewers prepare follow-up questions in real time
Reviewing technical questions like algorithms and system design
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI interview assistant that runs on a computer with a companion phone or tablet. The user practices or takes an interview on one device while the second device generates live AI answers. It offers an interview mode and a written-test mode, where a remote screenshot trigger lets the AI analyze online test questions across categories such as coding, aptitude, and data analysis. Listed features include one-click web-connected answers, reading screen text aloud, and automatic clipboard text sync between devices. The page claims data is stored only locally and that no interview records are kept.
notable: Written-test mode with remote screenshot solving, described as able to avoid detection
Dual-device linkage: computer for the interview and phone for real-time AI suggestions
Claimed 800ms AI suggestion latency and 50ms interview latency
Free credits for testing and invite-based referral rewards
caveats: Page says it offers a free quota for testing, but the full paid pricing is not stated; the listing marks it as paid
Page content is mostly marketing and testimonials; performance and usage figures are self-reported and unverified
Use in live interviews or tests may violate the rules of the employer or test provider; the page does not address this
